detail.jd:
Job highlights
3-6 years Java backend development with expertise in Java 8/11/17, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, and SQL databases
Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs; build scalable microservices; optimize performance and security; troubleshoot production issues; participate in code reviews and architecture discussions

Job description



Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
Build scalable Microservices-based applications.
Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Optimize application performance, security, and scalability.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues.
Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards.
Contribute to application architecture and technical design discussions.



Required Skills

3-6 years of experience in Java Backend Development.
Strong hands-on experience in:
Java 8/11/17
Spring Boot
Microservices
REST APIs
Spring MVC
Spring Data JPA / Hibernate
SQL (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Knowledge of Design Patterns and OOP concepts.
Understanding of Agile development methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



Preferred Skills

Experience with Kafka/RabbitMQ.
Exposure to Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
Experience with Redis or other caching technologies.
